title.original: PRISM: Probabilistic Runtime Insights and Scalable Performance Modeling for Large-Scale Distributed Training
title.zh: PRISM：用于大规模分布式训练的概率运行时洞察和可扩展性能建模
title.en: PRISM: Probabilistic Runtime Insights and Scalable Performance Modeling for Large-Scale Distributed Training

inclusion_reason.zh: PRISM 把随机故障与性能波动转化为训练完成时间分布和概率保证，为超大集群规划提供系统测量基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: PRISM converts random disruption and performance variation into completion-time distributions and guarantees, providing systems-measurement infrastructure for extreme-scale planning.

abstract.zh: PRISM 用概率性能模型描述超大规模分布式训练中的随机中断与运行时波动，为训练完成时间提供概率保证并支持风险感知的系统决策。
abstract.en: PRISM models random disruptions and runtime variability in very large distributed training, producing probabilistic guarantees on completion time for risk-aware system decisions.

problem.zh: 当训练扩展到数万 GPU，故障、功率限制和热压力使吞吐不再是固定值，传统平均性能模型无法表达尾部延迟和完成风险。
problem.en: At tens of thousands of GPUs, failures, power limits, and thermal stress make throughput stochastic, so average-case models cannot express tail delay or completion risk.

approach.zh: 框架从运行时变化分布出发建立统计模型，计算不同系统设计下的训练时间置信保证，并据此探索可变性条件下的优化空间。
approach.en: The framework builds a statistical model from runtime-variation distributions, computes confidence guarantees for training time under candidate designs, and explores variability-aware optimizations.

system_design.zh: 测量层汇集 GPU 时间和中断样本，概率核心拟合波动过程，场景分析器评估并行、冗余或资源策略，最后输出完成时间分布而非单点预测。
system_design.en: A measurement layer collects GPU-time and disruption samples, a probabilistic core fits the variability process, a scenario engine evaluates resource and parallelism choices, and the output is a completion-time distribution rather than a point estimate.

key_results.zh: PRISM 揭示在超大集群中忽略波动会误判训练生产率，并可用概率保证区分更稳健的系统配置。
key_results.en: PRISM shows that ignoring variability can misestimate productivity at extreme scale and that probabilistic guarantees distinguish more robust system configurations.

limitations.zh: 模型质量依赖具有代表性的故障和热功率数据；未知相关故障、工作负载变化和未来硬件可能破坏已拟合分布。
limitations.en: Model quality depends on representative failure, thermal, and power data; unseen correlated failures, workload shifts, and future hardware can invalidate fitted distributions.

workloads: probabilistic completion-time modeling for large-scale distributed training

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
